type=dev_object

# SOURCE
## app.roc
~~~roc
app [main] { pf: platform "./platform.roc" }

main = "Hello, World!"
~~~
## platform.roc
~~~roc
platform ""
    requires {} { main : Str }
    exposes []
    packages {}
    provides { "roc_main": main_for_host }
    targets: {
        inputs_dir: "targets/",
        x64glibc: { inputs: [app] },
    }

main_for_host : Str
main_for_host = main
~~~
# MONO
~~~roc
# platform
main_for_host = <required>

# app
main = "Hello, World!"

~~~
